whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a plugin version written as `+` or `latest.release`.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a plugin version written as `+` or `latest.release`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm settings.gradle no longer carries a plugin version written as `+` or `latest.release`.
